summary: Nyxoah SA filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Liam Kelly as Chief Executive Officer effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Olivier Taelman. The transition process was previously announced June 4, 2026, aimed at accelerating U.S. commercial traction. Kelly, former Chairman, President and CEO of Teleflex Incorporated (NYSE:TFX), brings extensive medical device leadership. No deal terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory mechanics apply. As a Belgium-domiciled foreign private issuer, this maps to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02 executive change. Watch for strategic shifts, potential M&A or commercial acceleration, and reconfirmation of 2026 guidance.
